mapper.select:
SELECT NULL::text AS coo_certify_no , fm.fta_code , fta.fta_name , fta.co_issue_flag , fm.sales_no , fm.sales_seq , fm.product_code , im.item_name AS product_name , fm.division_code , di.division_name , fm.hs_code , fm.rule_contents , fm.fta_coo_yn , fm.company_coo_yn , TO_CHAR(fm.coo_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS coo_date , sm.department_code , sm.bl_no , NULL::text AS new_certify_no , NULL::text AS cover_date , CASE WHEN fm.company_coo_yn = 'Y' THEN 'KR' ELSE 'Non-KR' END AS coo_yn_name , fta.cover_yn FROM fcr_mst fm INNER JOIN sales_mst sm ON fm.company_code = sm.company_code AND fm.division_code = sm.division_code AND fm.sales_no = sm.sales_no INNER JOIN fta_master fta ON fta.fta_code = fm.fta_code AND fta.company_code = fm.company_code AND fta.delete_yn = 'N' INNER JOIN item_mst im ON im.item_code = fm.product_code AND im.company_code = fm.company_code INNER JOIN division di ON di.division_code = fm.division_code AND di.company_code = fm.company_code WHERE fm.company_code = #{company_code} AND fm.fta_code = #{fta_code}
AND fm.sales_no IN
(#{item.salesNo})
ORDER BY fm.company_code , fm.division_code , fm.sales_no , fm.sales_seq , fm.product_code , fm.fta_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coo_certify_ledger ( coo_certify_no , division_code , company_code , customer_code , issue_type , export_flag , coo_type , issue_date , apply_date , end_date , department_code , bl_no , invoice_no , sign_seq , fta_category , origin_coo_certify_no , create_date , create_by , update_date , update_by ) VALUES ( #{coo_certify_no} , #{division_code} , #{company_code} , #{customer_code} , #{issue_type} , #{export_flag} , #{coo_type} , COALESCE( NULLIF(REPLACE(COALESCE(#{issue_date}, ''), '-', ''), ''), CASE WHEN #{coo_type} = 'C' THEN REPLACE(COALESCE(#{apply_date}, ''), '-', '') ELSE REPLACE(COALESCE(#{invoice_date}, ''), '-', '') END ) , CASE WHEN #{coo_type} = 'C' THEN REPLACE(COALESCE(#{apply_date}, ''), '-', '') ELSE NULL END , CASE WHEN #{coo_type} = 'C' THEN REPLACE(COALESCE(#{end_date}, ''), '-', '') ELSE NULL END , COALESCE(#{department_code}, '') , COALESCE(#{bl_no}, '') , #{invoice_no} , #{sign_seq} , #{fta_category} , COALESCE(#{origin_coo_certify_no}, '') , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP , #{create_by} , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP , #{update_by} )

INSERT INTO coo_certify_ledger_dtl ( coo_certify_no , sales_no , sales_seq , division_code , company_code , fta_code , product_code , standard , issue_date , apply_date , end_date , new_certify_no , customer_item_code , create_date , create_by , update_date , update_by ) VALUES ( #{coo_certify_no} , #{sales_no} , #{sales_seq} , #{division_code} , #{company_code} , #{fta_code} , #{product_code} , 0 , COALESCE( NULLIF(REPLACE(COALESCE(#{issue_date}, ''), '-', ''), ''), CASE WHEN #{coo_type} = 'C' THEN REPLACE(COALESCE(#{apply_date}, ''), '-', '') ELSE REPLACE(COALESCE(#{invoice_date}, ''), '-', '') END ) , CASE WHEN #{coo_type} = 'C' THEN REPLACE(COALESCE(#{apply_date}, ''), '-', '') ELSE NULL END , CASE WHEN #{coo_type} = 'C' THEN REPLACE(COALESCE(#{end_date}, ''), '-', '') ELSE NULL END , COALESCE(#{new_certify_no}, '') , #{customer_item_code} , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP , #{create_by} , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP , #{update_by} )
mapper.update: UPDATE sales_mst sm SET coo_certify_no = #{coo_certify_no} , coo_issue_type = CASE WHEN sm.export_flag = 'D' THEN '' ELSE ( SELECT co_issue_flag FROM fta_master WHERE delete_yn = 'N' AND fta_code = sm.target_fta_code AND company_code = sm.company_code ) END , update_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP , update_by = #{update_by} WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM coo_certify_ledger_dtl a WHERE a.sales_no = sm.sales_no AND a.division_code = sm.division_code AND a.company_code = sm.company_code AND a.coo_certify_no = #{coo_certify_no} )

UPDATE prod_sales_mst sm SET coo_certify_no = #{coo_certify_no} , coo_issue_type = CASE WHEN sm.export_flag = 'D' THEN '' ELSE ( SELECT co_issue_flag FROM fta_master WHERE delete_yn = 'N' AND fta_code = sm.target_fta_code AND company_code = sm.company_code ) END , update_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP , update_by = #{update_by} WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM coo_certify_ledger_dtl a WHERE a.sales_no = sm.sales_no AND a.division_code = sm.division_code AND a.company_code = sm.company_code AND a.coo_certify_no = #{coo_certify_no} )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coo_fcr_mst ( company_code, division_code, sales_seq, sales_no, fta_code, coo_certify_no, product_code, product_unit, product_assets_type, hs_code, standard, amount, net_cost_amount, exwork_amount, fob_amount, inarea_amount, outarea_amount, rule_contents, fta_coo_yn, company_coo_yn, coo_date, sp_coo_yn, im_apply_yn, create_date, create_by, update_date, update_by, certify_yn, biz_project_code, wo_coo_yn, weight, prod_division_code, decision_yn, rcep_coo_nation ) SELECT fm.company_code, fm.division_code, fm.sales_seq, fm.sales_no, fm.fta_code, ccld.coo_certify_no, fm.product_code, fm.product_unit, fm.product_assets_type, fm.hs_code, fm.standard, fm.amount, fm.net_cost_amount, fm.exwork_amount, fm.fob_amount, fm.inarea_amount, fm.outarea_amount, fm.rule_contents, fm.fta_coo_yn, fm.company_coo_yn, fm.coo_date, fm.sp_coo_yn, fm.im_apply_yn, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{create_by}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{update_by}, fm.certify_yn, fm.biz_project_code, fm.wo_coo_yn, fm.weight, fm.prod_division_code, fm.decision_yn, fm.rcep_coo_nation FROM coo_certify_ledger_dtl ccld INNER JOIN fcr_mst fm ON fm.company_code = ccld.company_code AND fm.division_code = ccld.division_code AND fm.sales_seq = ccld.sales_seq AND fm.sales_no = ccld.sales_no AND fm.fta_code = ccld.fta_code WHERE ccld.coo_certify_no = #{coo_certify_no}

INSERT INTO coo_fcr_dtl ( company_code, division_code, sales_seq, sales_no, fta_code, item_code, coo_certify_no, product_code, hs_code, standard, requirement_qty, input_amount, inarea_qty, inarea_amount, outarea_qty, outarea_amount, create_date, create_by, update_date, update_by, weight, cost_type, decision_yn, initial_origin_rate, input_origin_rate, price_note ) SELECT fd.company_code, fd.division_code, fd.sales_seq, fd.sales_no, fd.fta_code, fd.item_code, ccld.coo_certify_no, fd.product_code, fd.hs_code, fd.standard, fd.requirement_qty, fd.input_amount, fd.inarea_qty, fd.inarea_amount, fd.outarea_qty, fd.outarea_amount, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{create_by}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{update_by}, fd.weight, fd.cost_type, fd.decision_yn, fd.initial_origin_rate, fd.input_origin_rate, fd.price_note FROM coo_certify_ledger_dtl ccld INNER JOIN fcr_dtl fd ON fd.company_code = ccld.company_code AND fd.division_code = ccld.division_code AND fd.sales_seq = ccld.sales_seq AND fd.sales_no = ccld.sales_no AND fd.fta_code = ccld.fta_code WHERE ccld.coo_certify_no = #{coo_certify_no}

INSERT INTO coo_fcr_result ( company_code, division_code, sales_seq, sales_no, fta_code, seq, coo_certify_no, product_code, hs_code, standard, rule_seq, rule_code, ctc_yn, fta_result_rate, company_result_rate, fta_coo_yn, company_coo_yn, buffer_option, de_minimis_rate, rvc_rate, remark, delete_yn, create_date, create_by, update_date, update_by, status, error_code, error_msg, exclusion_yn, exclusion_condition, ctc_result_rate, ctc_fta_result_rate, ctc_company_result_rate, rvc_result_rate, rvc_fta_result_rate, rvc_company_result_rate, sp_coo_yn, wo_coo_yn, fta_de_minimis_yn, company_de_minimis_yn, fta_rvc_yn, company_rvc_yn ) SELECT fr.company_code, fr.division_code, fr.sales_seq, fr.sales_no, fr.fta_code, fr.seq, ccld.coo_certify_no, fr.product_code, fr.hs_code, fr.standard, fr.rule_seq, fr.rule_code, fr.ctc_yn, fr.fta_result_rate, fr.company_result_rate, fr.fta_coo_yn, fr.company_coo_yn, fr.buffer_option, fr.de_minimis_rate, fr.rvc_rate, fr.remark, fr.delete_yn, fr.create_date, fr.create_by, fr.update_date, fr.update_by, fr.status, fr.error_code, fr.error_msg, fr.exclusion_yn, fr.exclusion_condition, fr.ctc_result_rate, fr.ctc_fta_result_rate, fr.ctc_company_result_rate, fr.rvc_result_rate, fr.rvc_fta_result_rate, fr.rvc_company_result_rate, fr.sp_coo_yn, fr.wo_coo_yn, fr.fta_de_minimis_yn, fr.company_de_minimis_yn, fr.fta_rvc_yn, fr.company_rvc_yn FROM coo_certify_ledger_dtl ccld INNER JOIN fcr_result fr ON fr.company_code = ccld.company_code AND fr.division_code = ccld.division_code AND fr.sales_seq = ccld.sales_seq AND fr.sales_no = ccld.sales_no AND fr.fta_code = ccld.fta_code WHERE ccld.coo_certify_no = #{coo_certify_no}
mapper.select: SELECT ccl.coo_certify_no , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(ccl.issue_date, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS view_issue_date , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(ccl.apply_date, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS view_cover_from_date , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(ccl.end_date, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS view_cover_to_date , cfm.product_code , im.item_name AS product_name , cfm.hs_code , cfm.fta_code , fm.fta_name , cfm.product_assets_type , CASE WHEN cfm.product_assets_type = 'M' THEN '상품판정' ELSE cfm.rule_contents END AS rule_contents , cfm.company_coo_yn AS coo_yn , CASE WHEN cfm.company_coo_yn = 'Y' THEN 'KR' ELSE 'Non-KR' END AS coo_yn_name ,fm.cover_yn ,ccl.export_flag ,ccl.issue_date ,ccl.apply_date ,ccl.end_date ,ccl.division_code FROM coo_certify_ledger ccl INNER JOIN coo_certify_ledger_dtl ccd ON ccd.coo_certify_no = ccl.coo_certify_no AND ccd.company_code = ccl.company_code AND ccd.division_code = ccl.division_code INNER JOIN coo_fcr_mst cfm ON cfm.coo_certify_no = ccd.coo_certify_no AND cfm.company_code = ccd.company_code AND cfm.division_code = ccd.division_code AND cfm.sales_no = ccd.sales_no AND cfm.sales_seq = ccd.sales_seq AND cfm.fta_code = ccd.fta_code INNER JOIN fta_master fm ON fm.fta_code = cfm.fta_code AND fm.company_code = ccl.company_code LEFT JOIN item_mst im ON im.item_code = cfm.product_code AND im.company_code = cfm.company_code WHERE ccl.coo_certify_no = #{coo_certify_no} AND ccl.company_code = #{company_code} ORDER BY cfm.product_code, cfm.fta_code

SELECT ccl.coo_certify_no , ccl.company_code , ccl.division_code , ccl.customer_code , cfm.sales_no , cfm.sales_seq , sm.invoice_date FROM coo_fcr_mst cfm INNER JOIN coo_certify_ledger ccl ON cfm.coo_certify_no = ccl.coo_certify_no AND cfm.company_code = ccl.company_code AND cfm.division_code = ccl.division_code INNER JOIN sales_mst sm ON sm.company_code = cfm.company_code AND sm.division_code = cfm.division_code AND sm.sales_no = cfm.sales_no WHERE cfm.company_code = #{company_code} AND cfm.coo_certify_no = #{origin_coo_certify_no} ORDER BY product_code, fta_code, sales_no, sales_seq LIMIT 1

SELECT distinct ccl.coo_certify_no , ccl.company_code , ccl.division_code , ccl.customer_code , ccd.sales_no , ccd.sales_seq , sm.invoice_date , ccd.fta_code FROM coo_certify_ledger ccl INNER JOIN coo_certify_ledger_dtl ccd ON ccd.coo_certify_no = ccl.coo_certify_no AND ccd.company_code = ccl.company_code AND ccd.division_code = ccl.division_code INNER JOIN sales_mst sm ON sm.company_code = ccd.company_code AND sm.division_code = ccd.division_code AND sm.sales_no = ccd.sales_no WHERE ccl.company_code = #{company_code} AND ccl.coo_certify_no = #{origin_coo_certify_no} ORDER BY ccd.sales_no, ccd.sales_seq
